reason: A standalone program has no execution in the application domain after that domain has ceased to exist.
After all references are gone and finalization has ended, no defined operation can access the instance field to observe its cessation.
After every array reference is gone, no defined operation can access an element to observe its cessation.
An uncaptured parameter has no defined access after its function body completes, so its storage's cessation is unobservable.
Returning a reference preserves the referent rather than the parameter variable, which has no defined access after the function body completes.
The caller can observe the referent after return but has no defined access to the completed invocation's output-parameter variable itself.
The caller can observe the referent after return but has no defined access to the completed invocation's input-parameter variable itself.

The initial do-body edge is always present and no assignment can undo an assigned state, so its join already excludes assignment for any variable merely assigned after false on the backedge; no legal goto can bypass that initial edge by entering the nested body block.

A yield-break endpoint is unreachable and therefore treated as assigned by 9.4.4.2; finally-entry state comes from the try entry rather than yield break, and iterator parameters cannot be out, leaving no defined observation of its unchanged internal state.

Class this expressions are classified as values by 12.8.13, so source code cannot obtain a variable_reference to the implicit class-this parameter to distinguish its function-member context from the nearest enclosing value context.

A Boolean read has only the two language-defined values, so every observed value during overlapping true/false writes is also an allowed atomic result; inspecting its physical representation is outside the portable Boolean semantics.
A Boolean write cannot expose an intermediate third Boolean value, so a standalone program cannot distinguish tearing from an atomic true/false write without imposing a nonstandard representation.
